about.title: About the Cosmic Eclipse set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Cosmic Eclipse is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 1 November 2019. It has 271 cards: 236 in the main set and 35 secret rares. There are also 193 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 236 main set cards), the Master set (429 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 464 cards, adding the 35 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
